names.note: Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's own heading for 12. јануар ст. ст. (civil 2026-01-25), „Преподобна Мати Теодора“. The rank word „Преподобна“ is left off, and so is „Мати“, which is how the Prologue addresses a nun and not part of her name. The heading gives no epithet, so the form is bare.

death.note: The Ohrid Prologue: „Упокојила се мирно почетком V века.“ — she reposed in peace at the beginning of the fifth century. The entry gives no year.
